title: Junior Quality Engineering
description: We are looking for a Junior Quality Engineer to support our Customer Payments team in maintaining high quality standards across global payment platforms. You will enhance testing processes, execute automated tests, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Ideal for candidates with foundational test automation knowledge and a proactive, collaborative approach.

title: Android Engineer
description: Become part of our team as an Android Engineer, contributing to the design, development, and maintenance of our apps. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and participate in the full software development lifecycle. Ideal for candidates with strong Android expertise and experience in CI/CD practices.

title: Senior Android Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer to design and implement robust architectural patterns that impact millions of daily active users. Join our dynamic team and collaborate with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, and Backend Teams to build high-performance features.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description: Join our team as a Senior Security Engineer to design, build, and deploy security solutions for JET's cloud-native platforms. You will work with 1st and 2nd line InfoSec teams, focusing on vulnerability scanning, access monitoring, and AI security guardrails. Ideal for experienced engineers with strong cloud-native and AI security expertise.

title: Senior Product Manager - Partner Algorithms
description: We are recruiting a Senior Product Manager - Partner Algorithms to define and lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for ranking and recommendation systems. Drive product discovery and collaborate with data scientists and engineering teams. Ideal for candidates with extensive experience in data-driven product management and a passion for customer experience.

title: Data Security Specialist
description: We are seeking a Data Security Specialist to engineer and implement robust data protection controls across cloud-native and enterprise environments. You will oversee DLP and encryption solutions, manage automated data discovery, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Ideal candidates bring proven experience in data security engineering and automation.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description: We are seeking a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to drive AI innovation within Just Eat Takeaway. Collaborate with internal teams and technology partners, focusing on workflow optimisation and technical evaluation. Ideal for candidates with strong software engineering and AI fundamentals, and experience in building AI applications or evaluation systems.

title: Senior Software Developer, Android Native
description: We are seeking a Senior Software Developer, Android Native to architect and develop high-performance, scalable native Android applications for our logistics domain. You will design robust UIs, optimise performance, and mentor peers in a fast-paced environment. Ideal candidates have extensive Android development experience and a strong engineering mindset.

title: Operational Governance Lead
description: Embrace the role of an Operational Governance Lead and drive the delivery of secure, compliant, and governance frameworks for a leading cloud platform. Collaborate across engineering, risk, and compliance teams, ensuring robust policy implementation and continuous improvement in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Shape the future of information security at JET.

title: Head of Engineering - Data Platforms
description: Join our team as Head of Engineering - Data Platforms and lead the evolution of real-time data platforms at Just Eat Takeaway.com. Drive strategy, build high-performing teams, and shape the future of data architecture in a dynamic, global environment. Make a real impact on data-driven innovation and operational excellence.

title: Senior .Net Engineer
description: We are recruiting a Senior .Net Engineer to optimise our customer order platform, ensuring seamless order journeys for global customers. You will design and develop scalable software solutions, implement new features, and maintain code quality. Ideal candidates have strong .NET and C# expertise, with experience in both SQL and NoSQL databases.

title: Lead Data Security Engineer
description: Exciting opportunity for a Lead Data Security Engineer to define and implement security strategies for a global online delivery platform. Drive proactive defence, collaborate with data teams, and ensure enterprise-wide resilience. Ideal for candidates with deep technical expertise in data security and a collaborative, ethical approach.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description: Become part of our team as a Senior Data Engineer, driving the evolution of Mobius, our unified analytics and data platform. Lead the design and improvement of batch processing capabilities, collaborating with global teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. Ideal for experienced engineers with strong coding skills and a passion for innovation.

title: Full-stack Software Engineer
description: Join our team as a Full-stack Software Engineer, contributing to innovative menu solutions and customer-facing features. You will work across the full stack, focusing on Java/Spring Boot, React, and RESTful APIs. Ideal for candidates with experience in backend development and modern web technologies.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description: Join our team as a Senior Golang Engineer to lead the design and implementation of high-volume POS and menu integrations for global brands. Drive system architecture, mentor engineers, and ensure robust, scalable solutions. Ideal for experienced Go developers with strong architectural and cloud expertise.

title: Golang Engineer
description: Join us as a Golang Engineer and play a key role in building and scaling high-volume POS and menu integrations for Just Eat Takeaway. You will develop robust microservices in Go, contribute to system design, and collaborate across teams. Ideal for candidates with solid Go experience and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
